## What this region is

The doc-comment DSL: how custom metadata is written in a Prisma schema and recorded under on models, fields and indexes of the PrismaMap.

## What it exists for

- Read custom /// tag metadata off models, fields and indexes

## How people say these problems

A moment that says any of these, or something close, is this region's. Both voices: the user asking or correcting, and the agent describing what it is about to build.

- read the custom tags on this field
- parse the @tag text from a doc comment
- which models are tagged in the schema
- attach custom metadata to a model or field in the schema
- while changing the library, collect doc comments per model
- parse the tag text out of a doc comment
- Prisma rejects my custom attribute on the field
- I'll scan the schema lines for triple-slash comments
- I'll regex the key value pairs from the comment
- I'll keep a separate config of which fields are searchable
- maintainer work on how comments bind to declarations
- turn a tag string into a nested object
- tag this index for fuzzy search

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- list a self-relation's parent and children with their foreign keys → columns-and-relations
- build the map from the generated client → building-the-map
- which fields of an index are covered → map-shape
- the mapped column name for raw SQL → db-identifiers
